scenarioStory.history: Patient was gardening in her backyard when she developed progressive wheeze and chest tightness over the past 20 minutes. She has a known history of mild persistent asthma, typically well controlled, with symptoms usually triggered by seasonal outdoor allergens. She used her home albuterol inhaler once with only slight improvement before calling 911.
scenarioStory.course: Initial Contact: Crew arrives to find a 26-year-old female seated upright on the porch steps with audible expiratory wheeze, mild accessory muscle use, and able to speak in full sentences. → Duoneb and O2 started: Crew applies supplemental oxygen and administers a combined albuterol/ipratropium nebulizer treatment for the mild bronchospasm. → Improved after treatment: Wheeze and accessory muscle use have resolved after oxygen and a single nebulizer treatment. Patient is comfortable, speaking easily, and ready for transport.

scenarioEvents.name: Initial Contact
scenarioEvents.description: Crew arrives to find a 26-year-old female seated upright on the porch steps with audible expiratory wheeze, mild accessory muscle use, and able to speak in full sentences.
relatedChecklist: Auscultate breath sounds, assess air entry and work of breathing
Apply supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula, titrate to SpO2 94-98%
Albuterol 5 mg nebulized with ipratropium 0.5 mg nebulized, combined treatment

scenarioEvents.name: Duoneb and O2 started
scenarioEvents.description: Crew applies supplemental oxygen and administers a combined albuterol/ipratropium nebulizer treatment for the mild bronchospasm.
relatedChecklist: Reassess breath sounds, vital signs, and work of breathing after treatment

scenarioEvents.name: Improved after treatment
scenarioEvents.description: Wheeze and accessory muscle use have resolved after oxygen and a single nebulizer treatment. Patient is comfortable, speaking easily, and ready for transport.

scenarioEvents.name: Duoneb delayed
scenarioEvents.description: The crew delays administering the nebulized bronchodilator treatment. Wheeze and work of breathing worsen, and the patient becomes more anxious and tachypneic.
relatedChecklist: Recognize worsening bronchospasm; start albuterol 5 mg with ipratropium 0.5 mg nebulized without further delay
